name: gizza-ai/join-lines
summary: Join multiple lines of text into a single line with a chosen separator

tool.description: Join the lines of a block of text into one line. separator (default ", ") is placed between lines; backslash escapes \t, \n, \r and \\ are decoded, and an empty separator concatenates with nothing between. Set trim to strip surrounding whitespace from each line, remove_blank to drop blank lines, and prefix/suffix to wrap each line (e.g. quotes for a CSV list or parentheses for a SQL IN clause). Returns the joined line plus line counts. Runs locally.

text.description: The multi-line text whose lines should be joined into one.

separator.description: String placed between lines. Escapes \t, \n, \r and \\ are decoded, so use \t for a tab or an empty string to concatenate with no separator.

trim.description: Strip leading/trailing whitespace from each line before joining.

remove_blank.description: Drop blank/whitespace-only lines instead of joining them.

prefix.description: Text added to the start of every line before joining (e.g. a quote for a CSV list).

suffix.description: Text added to the end of every line before joining.
